ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Suspicious WDAC Policy File Creation
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious Windows Defender Application Control (WDAC) policy file creation from abnormal processes that could be abused by attacker to block EDR/AV components while allowing their own malicious code to run on the system.

sequences.query: file_path = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\CodeIntegrity\\\\.*") AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\Microsoft\\\.ConfigurationManagement\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\WDAC\\ Wizard\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\PowerShell\\\\7\\-preview\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\PowerShell\\\\7\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\dllhost\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\WindowsPowerShell\\\\v1\\\.0\\\\powershell\\_ise\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\WindowsPowerShell\\\\v1\\\.0\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\dllhost\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\WindowsPowerShell\\\\v1\\\.0\\\\powershell\\_ise\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\WindowsPowerShell\\\\v1\\\.0\\\\powershell\\\.exe$")) OR ((process_command_line = RGX(".*ConvertFrom\\-CIPolicy\\ \\-XmlFilePath.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-BinaryFilePath\\ .*")) OR process_command_line = RGX(".*CiTool\\ \\-\\-update\\-policy.*") OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*Copy\\-Item\\ \\-Path.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-Destination.*"))) OR process_path = "System")
